description: This file contains implementation code for GUID Partition Table (GPT) and composite disk image generation, including functions for creating partition tables, handling different disk image formats, and assembling composite disk images with GPT headers and footers.

classes.name: CompositeDiskBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for creating GPT partition tables and composite disk images, managing partitions, generating headers and footers, and producing disk specifications.

methods.name: ProtectiveMbr
methods.description: Creates a protective MBR partition table header to protect GPT disks.

methods.name: ExpandedStorageSize
methods.description: Calculates the expanded size of disk images, supporting composite disk images, Qcow2, Android-Sparse, and raw files.

methods.name: ToMultipleImagePartition
methods.description: Converts an ImagePartition to a MultipleImagePartition structure.

methods.name: SetRandomUuid
methods.description: Generates a random UUID for GPT disk and partition headers.

methods.name: AlignToPartitionSize
methods.description: Aligns a size to the partition size boundary.
